title: GitHub Repository Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: GitHub repositories (`github:repo`), commits (`github:commit`), issues (`github:issue`), and releases (`github:release`).
app: GitHub repository metadata, commit activity feeds, issue trackers, and release publish logs forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=github:repo
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by repo_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>168
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when GitHub repository data has stopped arriving for a given repository.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per repository and alert when the feed is older than 168 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when one part of your GitHub repository feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
